explanation: Adds data/expression/visium/README.md, the runbook for the HYPOMAP human Visium reference: the pinned RDS (URL, bytes, MD5, SHA-256), the four tracked donor x region tables written by scripts/extract_visium_reference.R, the derivation (donor x region cells with at least 10 spots, CPM from summed counts and library sizes, six significant digits), the sparse-region and compartment rules, what the builder checks, the one-off DuckDB cross-check against the Parquet export, and the CC BY 4.0 attribution. No existing analysis output or producer changed. The tables were re-extracted on 2026-11-27 under R 4.6.0 (Seurat 6.0.0, SeuratObject 5.4.0, Matrix 1.7.5) and were byte-identical to the R 4.4.1 extraction; the manifest now records the R 4.6.0 runtime, and the extractor uses GetAssayData(layer =) because SeuratObject 5.4 made slot = an error.
